class.name: AudioStreamFluidSynth
class.brief_description: AudioStream that is the FluidSynth synthesizer.
class.description: AudioStreamFluidSynth is a self-contained [AudioStream] resource that owns a [code]fluid_settings_t[/code] and [code]fluid_synth_t[/code], along with the SoundFont and MIDI data it renders. Settings surface as exported properties ([member sample_rate], [member gain], [member polyphony]) applied to the settings object at init. It carries no transport and no controls — it only renders. Assign it as the [member AudioStreamPlayer.stream] of an [AudioStreamPlayerFluidSynth] node, which drives it through [AudioStreamPlaybackFluidSynth].

method.name: set_soundfont
method.description: Loads the [SoundFontFileReader] at [param soundfont] and stores it as this stream's SoundFont.

method.name: get_soundfont
method.description: Returns the stored [SoundFontFileReader], or [code]null[/code] if none has been set.

method.name: set_midi_file
method.description: Stores [param midi_file] as this stream's MIDI data.

method.name: get_midi_file
method.description: Returns the stored [MidiFileReader], or [code]null[/code] if none has been set.

method.name: set_sample_rate
method.description: Sets the FluidSynth sample rate in hertz.

method.name: get_sample_rate
method.description: Returns the FluidSynth sample rate in hertz.

method.name: set_polyphony
method.description: Sets the FluidSynth voice polyphony limit.

method.name: get_polyphony
method.description: Returns the FluidSynth voice polyphony limit.

members.member: MIDI resource rendered when playback starts.
